    // True when the curve is (near) planar at t: torsion within the given
    // non-negative tolerance of zero.
    IsPlanarAt(self: IDifferentiableCurve3D, t: Number, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.TorsionAt(t).Abs <= tolerance;

    //==
    // # IFramedCurve3D
    //
    // A 3D curve carrying a continuous moving frame whose origin lies on the
    // curve and whose Z axis is tangent. The frame's axes give ready-made
    // tangent, normal, and binormal directions for sweeps and camera paths.

    // The frame origin at t, which lies on the curve.
    FrameOriginAt(self: IFramedCurve3D, t: Number): Point3D
        => self.FrameAt(t).Origin;

    // The unit tangent direction at t (the frame's Z axis).
    TangentDirectionAt(self: IFramedCurve3D, t: Number): Direction3D
        => self.FrameAt(t).ZAxis;

    // The unit normal direction at t (the frame's X axis).
    NormalDirectionAt(self: IFramedCurve3D, t: Number): Direction3D
        => self.FrameAt(t).XAxis;

    // The unit binormal direction at t (the frame's Y axis).
    BinormalDirectionAt(self: IFramedCurve3D, t: Number): Direction3D
        => self.FrameAt(t).YAxis;

    //==
    // # IPlanarCurve3D
    //
    // A 3D curve lying entirely within a single plane, reported by CurvePlane.

    // The unit normal of the plane the curve lies in.
    PlaneNormal(self: IPlanarCurve3D): Direction3D
        => self.CurvePlane.Normal;

    // The signed offset of the curve's plane from the origin along its normal.
    PlaneOffset(self: IPlanarCurve3D): Number
        => self.CurvePlane.Distance;

    //==
    // # IPolarCurve2D
    //
    // A plane curve in polar form: RadiusAt(theta) gives the distance from the
    // origin at angle theta.

    // The polar coordinate (radius, angle) of the curve at the given angle.
    PolarPositionAt(self: IPolarCurve2D, angle: Angle): PolarCoordinate
        => (self.RadiusAt(angle), angle);

    // The Cartesian position of the curve at the given angle:
    // (RadiusAt(angle)*cos angle, RadiusAt(angle)*sin angle). Note: evaluates
    // RadiusAt twice; concrete types with expensive radii should override.
    CartesianPositionAt(self: IPolarCurve2D, angle: Angle): Point2D
        => (self.RadiusAt(angle) * angle.Cos, self.RadiusAt(angle) * angle.Sin);

    // The diameter across the origin implied by the radius at the given angle.
    DiameterAt(self: IPolarCurve2D, angle: Angle): Number
        => self.RadiusAt(angle).Double;

    // True when the curve passes through the pole at the given angle: radius
    // within the given non-negative tolerance of zero.
    IsAtPole(self: IPolarCurve2D, angle: Angle, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.RadiusAt(angle).Abs <= tolerance;

    //==
    // # IArcLengthParameterized<TPoint>
    //
    // A curve measurable by arc length: ArcLength is the total length,
    // PointAtLength walks a distance from the start, ParameterAtLength converts a
    // distance to the canonical parameter. TPoint is the concrete point type
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arc_length).

    // The point at the start of the curve (zero distance travelled).
    ArcStartPoint(self: IArcLengthParameterized<$T>): $T
        => self.PointAtLength(0.0);

    // The point at the far end of the curve (the full arc length travelled).
    ArcEndPoint(self: IArcLengthParameterized<$T>): $T
        => self.PointAtLength(self.ArcLength);

    // The point halfway along the curve by arc length.
    ArcMidPoint(self: IArcLengthParameterized<$T>): $T
        => self.PointAtLength(self.ArcLength.Half);

    // The point a given fraction of the total length along the curve. Fraction 0
    // is the start, 1 the end. Precondition: fraction in [0, 1].
    PointAtLengthFraction(self: IArcLengthParameterized<$T>, fraction: Number): $T
        => self.PointAtLength(self.ArcLength * fraction);

    // The canonical parameter a given fraction of the total length along the
    // curve. Precondition: fraction in [0, 1].
    ParameterAtLengthFraction(self: IArcLengthParameterized<$T>, fraction: Number): Number
        => self.ParameterAtLength(self.ArcLength * fraction);

    // The fraction of the total length that the given distance represents, in
    // [0, 1] for distances within the curve. Precondition: ArcLength > 0.
    LengthFraction(self: IArcLengthParameterized<$T>, length: Number): Number
        => length / self.ArcLength;

    // True when a distance lies within the curve, i.e. in [0, ArcLength].
    IsValidLength(self: IArcLengthParameterized<$T>, length: Number): Boolean
        => length >= 0.0 && length <= self.ArcLength;

    //==
    // # Discretizing curves and surfaces
    //
    // Evaluating a curve, a polar curve, or a parametric surface at evenly spaced
    // parameters, and turning the samples into polylines. Split out of the curve
    // interface bodies because discretization is a single concern with a single
    // convention (open curves include both endpoints, closed ones omit the duplicate
    // seam) and because it is the one part of the curve package that reaches into
    // the P2 collection primitives.

    //==
    // # Sampling and discretization
    //
    // Evaluating a curve or surface at evenly spaced parameters. The
    // discretization primitives are `Fractions` (endpoints included, the right
    // form for an OPEN curve) and `FractionsExclusive` (upper end omitted, the
    // right form for a CLOSED one), both in
    // `collections.library.plato` (P2). P6 may call P2.
    //
    // A closed curve satisfies Eval(0) = Eval(1), so sampling it with
    // `Fractions` would duplicate the seam point; the periodic samplers below
    // use `FractionsExclusive` and hand `Closed = true` to the polyline, which
    // re-joins the ends itself.

    // `count` values evenly spaced over the canonical domain, endpoints
    // included. One body for every embedding, via the generic `ICurve<TRange>`
    // root: sampling needs `Eval` and nothing else. Precondition: count >= 2.
    Sample(self: ICurve<$TRange>, count: Integer): Array<$TRange>
        => count.Fractions.Map(t => self.Eval(t));

    // `count` values evenly spaced over one period, the duplicate seam value at
    // parameter 1 omitted. Precondition: count >= 1.
    SamplePeriodic(self: ICurve<$TRange>, count: Integer): Array<$TRange>
        => count.FractionsExclusive.Map(t => self.Eval(t));

    // The open polyline through `count` evenly spaced samples of the curve.
    // Precondition: count >= 2.
    ToPolyline2D(self: ICurve2D, count: Integer): Polyline2D
        => (self.Sample(count), false);

    // The open polyline through `count` evenly spaced samples of the curve.
    // Precondition: count >= 2.
    ToPolyline3D(self: ICurve3D, count: Integer): Polyline3D
        => (self.Sample(count), false);

    // The closed polyline through `count` evenly spaced samples of a closed
    // curve; the seam is left to the polyline's own Closed flag rather than
    // repeated as a point. Precondition: count >= 3.
    ToClosedPolyline2D(self: IClosedCurve2D, count: Integer): Polyline2D
        => (self.SamplePeriodic(count), true);
